subject: MAP checkpoint: close trajectory & pricing alignment (commit sizing + credits)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP checkpoint: close trajectory & pricing alignment (commit sizing + credits)

Hi Liam / Acme team —

Quick MAP checkpoint ahead of Monday's internal budget committee. I pulled together the latest action items and where we are on pricing alignment so we can unblock the commit conversation: 

Summary (short):
- Evaluation complete (pilot KPIs met).
- Customer success asks for 3-month trial traffic baseline before full cutover.
- Acme needs clarity on committed spend tiers and whether we can include a starter credit + ramping commit to meet procurement's gating.

Attached: redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones & owners) and pricing_summary_acme.pdf (proposed tier + optional credits).

This week’s asks:
- Acme: confirm target commit range (monthly $) and preferred invoice cadence by Mon EOD PT.
- Redwood: confirm any one-time credits (we typically bundle a starter credit for first billing cycle) and outline approval path if they need >15% discount.

Meeting notes + owners (high level):
- Pilot KPIs & signoff — Owner: Liam O'Neill (Acme) — target: 2028-05-10
- Commit sizing proposal (Redwood to propose two options: conservative & aggressive) — Owner: Vivek — deliverable: 2028-05-04 EOD
- Finance approval (internal) — Owner: Marcus — target decision: 2028-05-06
- Contract redlines & procurement document list — Owner: Marissa — draft to Acme: 2028-05-05

Vivek / Marcus / Marissa / Neha — can you review the attached pricing options and confirm what approval band we can offer if Acme's committee asks for a larger discount or elongated payment terms? I highlighted a conservative commit that doesn't need senior approval and an accelerated commit with a starter credit that will need Marcus' signoff.

Liam — is there anything missing from our MAP that would block your internal committee? If you can send the committee's preferred commit range, we can make the scenario concrete before your meeting.

Thanks —
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acmehealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: close trajectory & pricing alignment (commit sizing + credits)

Thanks Grace — really helpful summary. Two quick clarifications from procurement: 

1) Committee will want a clear 12-month commitment scenario (monthly $ + total) and an alternative 6-month pilot-to-commit plan. They want to see what the unit economics look like under both.
2) Procurement expects a named-starter credit (we asked for $75k) — that's not a hard ask but would materially change committee sentiment. If Redwood can offer a starter credit plus a 10–12% list discount on committed tiers, we can likely get an internal approval window for May 15.

I can confirm exact preferred cadence after our internal call Monday, but aim is to have a final Redwood proposal by Tue 2028-05-09.

Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform Procurement
Acme Health
liam.oneill@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: close trajectory & pricing alignment (commit sizing + credits)

Agree with Liam — procurement will want concrete dollar scenarios. Quick thoughts from pricing: 

- Option A (Conservative): 6-month pilot -> 12-month commit at $45k/month (standard enterprise tier). No starter credit. This stays within standard approval (<15% discount).
- Option B (Aggressive): 12-month commit at $38.5k/month + one-time starter credit of $60k applied to first invoice (effectively ~12% net concession). This will require Marcus' finance signoff for credit and an exec exception for blended ARR price.

If Acme asks for the $75k starter credit, we'd need to shift to a higher commit (min $50k/mo) or escalate to VP sales for approval.

Action items: Vivek to draft both official price rows (A/B) and send to Marissa for contract insertion by EOD. Marcus — can you flag if B is approvable or if you need an exec memo?

-Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: close trajectory & pricing alignment (commit sizing + credits)

Thanks — I reviewed the attached pricing_summary_acme.pdf and updated redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx with explicit milestones and billing triggers. Key updates added to the MAP: 

- Billing trigger: Pilot signoff -> invoice starts at commit month 1.
- DocuSign flow: Proposed SOW + MSA + Appendix A (pricing rows A/B).
- Procurement deliverables checklist included (SOC report snapshot, data processing addendum, contact points).

Attached: redwood_MAP_v2.xlsx (v2 with billing triggers) — will upload to the shared drive link. Vivek: my preference is Option B if Marcus signs-off on the credit; otherwise Option A keeps it simple and faster. Marcus — can you confirm financial band (i.e., do we need VP approval for a $60k starter credit on RDW-334)? If yes, I will prepare an approval memo template.

Also flagging a potential ask from Acme on payment terms (Net45 vs Net30). If procurement pushes Net45, that may necessitate a slight uplift to the list price.

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0281
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: close trajectory & pricing alignment (commit sizing + credits)

Quick internal finance readout: 

- Option A (no credit) is green — finance can sign off without director approval.
- Option B (60k starter credit + 12% concession) requires director-level signoff. I'm available to present a short approval memo; key things I need from the deal team: 1) concrete ARR math showing retention assumptions, 2) proposed payment cadence, 3) any integrations or implementation costs we should capitalize.

If Acme insists on $75k starter credit, we should ask for a minimum $50k/mo commit and consider a 6-month accelerated payment schedule to mitigate cash exposure.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Vivek: send formal Option A/B pricing rows -> 2028-05-04 EOD (Owner: Vivek)
- Marissa: prepare contract SOW + DocuSign packet -> 2028-05-05 (Owner: Marissa)
- Grace: follow up with Liam on committee timing and confirm target commit range -> 2028-05-06 (Owner: Grace)
- Marcus: prepare approval memo if Option B escalates -> 2028-05-06 (Owner: Marcus)

I will block 30 minutes on Mon 2028-05-07 at 10:00 PT to review the memo if needed — invite to follow.

-Marcus
